newsitem.title: USA: ALLIANCE ENTERTAINMENT TO SELL RED ANT.
newsitem.headline: ALLIANCE ENTERTAINMENT TO SELL RED ANT.

text.p: Alliance Entertainment Corp said Thursday its directors approved an agreement to sell the company's Los Angeles-based new release product label, Red Ant Records, to an affiliate of Wasserstein Perella & Co.

The company said it will receive $625,000 in cash at closing and will retain a 10 percent interest in the equity of Red Ant. Additionally, Wasserstein Perella will provide future financing to Red Ant in an amount not less than $11 million with not less than $3 million of such financing to be provided at closing.
The minimum financing is to be increased to $19 million under certain circumstances, Alliance said without explanation.
The company said Wasserstein Perella's proposal was received in connection with the previously announced solicitation of bids for Red Ant by Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette.
Alliance said it is seeking Bankruptcy Court approval of the offer at a hearing scheduled for August 13.
Under bankruptcy law, it noted, the offer is subject to competing offers delivered no later than the August 13 hearing which are determined to be higher and better than the Wasserstein Perella offer.

In conjunction with the receipt of the offer to buy Red Ant, the court approved Alliance's request for an additional $625,000 in funding under its debtor-in-possession financing agreement to provide for the operation of Red Ant through completion of the sale.

Red Ant is an independent record label specializing in new product, primarily in the alternative rock and urban music genres, with a particular focus on the identification and development of new talent.
